<infobox theme="Deity">
	<image source="image"/>
	<title source="name"></title>
	<navigation name="mobile-eras"><center>{{Top-mobile}}</center></navigation>
	<group collapse="open">
		<header>Religious information</header>
		<data source="religion"><label>Associated religion</label></data>
		<data source="pantheon"><label>Pantheon</label></data>
		<data source="type"><label>Type of deity</label></data>
        <data source="powers"><label>Powers</label></data>
		<data source="worship"><label>Places of worship</label></data>
		<data source="artifacts"><label>Artifacts</label></data>
	</group>
	<group collapse="open">
		<header>Descriptive information</header>
		<data source="gender"><label>Gender</label></data>
		<data source="pronouns"><label>Pronouns</label><format><!--
        -->{{#ifeq:{{lc:{{{pronouns|}}}}}|new||{{#ifeq:{{lc:{{{pronouns|}}}}}|unspecified||{{{pronouns|}}}}}}}<!--
        --></format></data>
		<data source="form"><label>Form</label></data>
	</group>
	<group collapse="open">
		<header>Family information</header>
		<data source="parents"><label>Parent(s)</label><format><!--
        -->{{#ifeq:{{lc:{{{parents|}}}}}|new||{{{parents}}}}}<!--
        --></format></data>
		<data source="partners"><label>Partner(s)</label><format><!--
        -->{{#ifeq:{{lc:{{{partners|}}}}}|new||{{{partners}}}}}<!--
        --></format></data>
		<data source="siblings"><label>Sibling(s)</label><format><!--
        -->{{#ifeq:{{lc:{{{siblings|}}}}}|new||{{{siblings}}}}}<!--
        --></format></data>
		<data source="children"><label>Children</label><format><!--
        -->{{#ifeq:{{lc:{{{children|}}}}}|new||{{{children}}}}}<!--
        --></format></data>
	</group>
	<group collapse="open">
		<header>Chronological and political information</header>
                <data source="first"><label>First worshipped</label></data>
                <data source="area"><label>Area of influence</label></data>
		<data source="affiliation"><label>Affiliation</label></data>
	</group>
        <navigation><small>{{PlainLink|//starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Template:Deity|name=<nowiki>[</nowiki>Source<nowiki>]</nowiki>}}</small></navigation>
</infobox>{{PreloadCat}}<!-- TEMPLATE ENDS HERE. In order to regenerate the template, replace the code above with the source code provided. 

The following code flags infoboxes that do not have parameters defined.
-->{{#invoke:InfoboxParamCheck|main|image|name|religion|pantheon|type|powers|worship|artifacts|gender|form|first|area|affiliation|optional=pronouns,parents,partners,siblings,children|ignore=name}}<!--

The following code flags infoboxes that have no values assigned to the pronouns parameter
-->{{#ifeq:{{lc:{{{pronouns|}}}}}|new|[[Category:Articles with unpopulated pronoun parameters]]|}}<!--
-->{{#if:{{#ifeq:{{lc:{{{parents|}}}}}|new|1|}}{{#ifeq:{{lc:{{{partners|}}}}}|new|1|}}{{#ifeq:{{lc:{{{siblings|}}}}}|new|1|}}{{#ifeq:{{lc:{{{children|}}}}}|new|1|}}|[[Category:Articles with unpopulated family parameters]]|}}<!--
--><noinclude>{{Top|sprot}}{{clear}}

===Usage===
Paste the following code into the top of an article, filling all known fields:

<pre class="wrap"><nowiki>
{{Deity
|image=
|name=
|religion=
|pantheon=
|type=
|powers=
|worship=
|artifacts=
|gender=
|pronouns=
|form=
|first=
|area=
|parents=
|partners=
|siblings=
|children=
|affiliation=
}}</nowiki></pre>

[[Category:Character infobox templates]]</noinclude>
